verses.1: A Canticle Psalm. To the sons of Korah, on the second Sabbath.
verses.2: The Lord is great and exceedingly praiseworthy, in the city of our God, on his holy mountain.
verses.3: Mount Zion is being founded with the exultation of the whole earth, on the north side, the city of the great king.
verses.4: In her houses, God will be known, since he will support her.
verses.5: For behold, the kings of the earth have been gathered together; they have convened as one.
verses.6: Such did they see, and they were astonished: they were disturbed, they were moved.
verses.7: Trembling took hold of them. In that place, their pains were that of a woman in labor.
verses.8: With a vehement spirit, you will crush the ships of Tarshish.
verses.9: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God. God has founded it in eternity.
verses.10: We have received your mercy, O God, in the midst of your temple.
verses.11: According to your name, O God, so does your praise reach to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of justice.
verses.12: Let mount Zion rejoice, and let the daughters of Judah exult, because of your judgments, O Lord.
verses.13: Encircle Zion and embrace her. Discourse in her towers.
verses.14: Set your hearts on her virtue. And distribute her houses, so that you may discourse of it in another generation.
verses.15: For this is God, our God, in eternity and forever and ever. He will rule us forever. [ Psalm 48 ] (49)
